about: [O3] exploration (not a proof): punch a walker, watch the witnesses and the heat

steps.eval: (() => { const P = G.people, E = G.eye; const L = P.list.filter(p => p.role === 'walker' && p.standing).sort((a, b) => a.pos.distanceTo(E) - b.pos.distanceTo(E)); const p = L[0]; window.__v = p; const C = G.controller; const yaw = p.yaw; C.setPose(p.pos.x + Math.sin(yaw) * 1.3, p.pos.z + Math.cos(yaw) * 1.3, yaw, -0.15); p.stop(); p.mode = 'stand'; p.until = 30; p.t = 0; return [p.kind, P.list.length]; })()

JSON.stringify({ log: G.crime.log.map(r => [r.kind, r.level, r.seen, r.reporters]), heat: G.police.heat, v: window.__v.mode, rep: G.people.list.filter(p => p.mode === 'report').map(p => [p.kind, p.phase, p.reportTo.box ? 'box' : 'cop']) })

JSON.stringify({ heat: G.police.heat, state: G.police.state, rep: G.people.list.filter(p => p.mode === 'report').map(p => [p.kind, p.phase, +p.pos.distanceTo(G.eye).toFixed(1)]), ev: G.police.events.slice(-8) })

JSON.stringify({ heat: G.police.heat, state: G.police.state, stats: G.people.stats, ev: G.police.events.slice(-10), cops: G.police.cops.map(c => [c.job, c.mode, +c.pos.distanceTo(G.eye).toFixed(1)]), obj: G.hud.objectiveText })
JSON.stringify({ warn: G.hud.warnText, fail: G.lastFail, ev: G.police.events.slice(-6) })
JSON.stringify({ beat: G.scenes.beat, heat: G.police.heat, gun: G.people.hands.hasGun, eye: [G.eye.x.toFixed(1), G.eye.z.toFixed(1)], money: G.save.money })
